description: Free public services in or near an Italian municipality: state schools for adults (CPIA, free courses), Punti Digitale Facile (free help with SPID and online services), consultori familiari, camper areas and camper service points, plus coworking spaces, car sharing and bike sharing stations (these are not free services, they are listed for remote workers and people without a car). From official open data and OpenStreetMap, refreshed weekly.
